title: AdicFiniteEtaleOrigins
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $A$ a commutative Noetherian ring and $J$ an ideal. Use constant coefficient sheaves, module sheaves and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The normalized constructions are [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data]. For $N$ in the pro-etale derived category put $P_n=A/J^{n+1}$ and $N_n=N\otimes_A^L P_n$, and let $
u^*$ be the recorded comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let $C$ be a bounded constructible etale $P_0$-complex [def-pe-etale-constructible-module], and let $e:
u^*C\simeq N_0$. If every $N_n$ has Tor amplitude in the same interval $[a,b]$ [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude], then for each $n$ separately there is a bounded constructible etale $P_n$-complex $C_n$ of Tor amplitude $[a,b]$ and an isomorphism $
u^*C_n\simeq N_n$. There is no compatibility requirement and no prescribed choice at zero.

source.place: Tag 09C2, lemma-describe-constructible-complexes; Tag 09AL, lemma-compare-constructible-derived; parent proof steps specified below.

proof.text: Noetherian X is compact and quasi-separated by the existing scheme instances, and every quotient A/J^(n+1) is Noetherian. Use the normalized rings and reductions without changing their definitions.

Prove the ordinary pullback comparison locally: the constant inverse-image scalar normalization identifies its ring map with the transpose of the continuous constant-ring map. The supplied module adjunction in CompletedPullbackAdjunction and the site ringed-topos construction identify both functors as left adjoints of exactly the same module pushforward. Apply leftAdjointUniq. Map this isomorphism to cochain complexes and use leftDerivedNatIso: the adic functor is left derived by its recorded universal property; the comparison factorization is an isomorphism and the localization inverts quasi-isomorphisms, so it is left derived as well. These are proved private helpers, not new assumptions.

Apply the bounded constructible comparison equivalence to C with hC. Compose its forward comparison, the inverse of the derived pullback identification, and e. Isomorphism invariance of coefficient constructibility, and functorial transport of cohomological vanishing, give bounded constructibility of the residue reduction.

Apply the higher-reduction constructibility theorem to the bounded constructible residue. Independently, the flat-model characterization of the assumed Tor amplitude produces for each reduction a complex with flat terms supported in [a,b]. Homology of this representative vanishes outside [a,b], and homologyFunctorFactors transports the vanishing to the named reduction. Thus every reduction is bounded constructible and has finite Tor amplitude.

For each n put its reduction, bounded constructibility, and the given finite Tor interval into the target full subcategory of finiteTorComparisonNoetherian. Apply the inverse equivalence. Compose the inverse forward-comparison isomorphism with the included counit to identify the derived comparison of the resulting etale object with the named reduction. Compose with the derived pullback identification for the required adicFinitePullback isomorphism. Reflect the exact interval using the equivalence theorem and the elementary invariance of Tor tests under composition of representative isomorphisms. The construction is independent at each level.

proof_origin.description: C4 Lean assembly: prove ordinary and derived comparison normalization privately, transport residue constructibility, use the strictly cohomological coefficient-filtration step, bound by the existing flat model, and descend with the finite-Tor equivalence. The unit route through the Stacks integral criterion is retained.

lean.statement:
theorem adicFiniteEtale_origins
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (N : adicFiniteAmbient.{u, v} X A)
    (C : adicFiniteEtale.{u, v} X J 0)
    (hC : IsCoefficientBoundedConstructibleEtale.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J 0) C)
    (e : (adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J 0)).obj C ≅
      adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N 0)
    (a b : ℤ)
    (hTor : ∀ n : ℕ, HasCoefficientProEtaleTorAmplitude.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J n)
      (adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N n) a b) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ Cn : adicFiniteEtale.{u, v} X J n,
      IsCoefficientBoundedConstructibleEtale.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J n) Cn ∧
      HasCoefficientModelTorAmplitude
        (constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) (adicFiniteCoeff J n)) Cn a b ∧
      Nonempty ((adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J n)).obj Cn ≅
        adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N n)
